Title: Harrowgate cafe owners feel the pinch
Outlet: Corvenia Courier
Publication Date: 2025-03-16
Source Type: news_report
Event ID: EVT-A
Country: Brenmark
Sector: electronics
Reliability Tier: 3

Owners of the Café Brønd near Harrowgate say fewer dock crews come in since the canal closed. Åsa Lind, who runs the café, said trade was down by a third.
